target.title: fix(sessions): reject malformed history offsets
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users requesting `sessions_history` pagination could pass malformed string offsets such as `"1abc"` and have them accepted as offset `1` instead of being rejected before `chat.history` dispatch.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both the public `sessions_history` tool and the embedded `chat.history` gateway stub now reuse the existing strict non-negative integer parameter reader for `offset`, matching the schema contract and the strict `limit` parsing already used in the same paths. This keeps the fix local to the session history owner boundary and avoids changing pagination behavior for valid numeric offsets.

## User Impact

Malformed offset values are rejected consistently, so session-history pagination cannot silently run from a different page than the caller requested.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: malformed string offsets are rejected in both `sessions_history` and embedded `chat.history`, while existing valid offset pagination behavior remains covered.
- Current-head proof at `3a600cc59afa598af05883cbef5cabeacfbb370d`: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/sessions-history-tool.test.ts src/agents/tools/embedded-gateway-stub.test.ts` passed with 2 files and 27 tests.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode commit --commit HEAD` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Duplicate search: open PR/issue searches for `sessions_history offset non-negative integer`, `readNumberParam offset parseFloat`, and `offset must be a non-negative integer` found no active competing fix.
